recipes.title: Soup, chinese herb and chicken
recipes.description: 黨參當歸雞 - Dang Shen (codonopsis) and Dang Gui (angelica) chicken soup.
ingredients: 5 slice 當歸 (dang gui / angelica root)
2 pieces 黨參 (dang shen / codonopsis root)
1 tbsp 杞子 (goji berries) / 南北杏 (north & south almonds)
steps: Add all ingredients to an Instant Pot: 30 min soup setting.
Let it decompress, then saute on high 20 min.
